name: Angela Cutbill
office: Las Virgenes Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Angela Cutbill is vice president of the Las Virgenes Unified School District Governing Board. She was first elected in 2013. She has volunteered with the district for over two decades. In 2013, she said she served as a PFA president and on school and district committees.

sentences.text: Angela Cutbill is vice president of the Las Virgenes Unified School District Governing Board.
She has volunteered with the district for over two decades.
In 2013, she said she served as a PFA president and on school and district committees.

items.text: In her 2022 campaign, Cutbill said the district added full-time counselors, elementary music and arts teachers, and a family counseling center during her tenure. She also stated LVUSD was the first public school district in Los Angeles County to reopen for in-person instruction with increased safety protocols. At the time, she wanted to challenge the state funding formula, stating the district was in the bottom 15% for per-pupil funding.
